armyRules.name: Martial Ka’tah
armyRules.text:
Each time a unit with this ability is selected to fight, select one of the Ka'tah stances below. Until that unit has finished making its attacks, the selected Stance is active for it and it gains the relevant ability.

■ DACATARAI STANCE
Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.
■ RENDAX STANCE
Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

rule.name: Against All Odds
rule.text: Each time an ^^**Adeptus Custodes^^** unit from your army (excluding ^^**Vehicles^^**) makes an attack, if there are no other friendly units within 6" of that unit, add 1 to the Hit roll and add 1 to the Wound roll.

Gilded Champion.name: GILDED CHAMPION
Gilded Champion.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet that states it can only be used ‘once per battle’.
Gilded Champion.effect: Your model can use that ‘once per battle’ ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase).
Gilded Champion.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.
Gilded Champion.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet that states it can only be used ‘once per battle’.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.

EFFECT: Your model can use that ‘once per battle’ ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.
Gilded Champion.flavour: The shining champions of the Adeptus Custodes are looked upon in awe by all who witness their grim arts. Their judgement is without flaw, and their tactical acumen utterly impeccable.

Defiant to the Last.name: DEFIANT TO THE LAST
Defiant to the Last.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Defiant to the Last.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Defiant to the Last.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if that model has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is treated as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
Defiant to the Last.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 2 to the result if that model has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is treated as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
Defiant to the Last.flavour: The harder the battle, and the heavier their losses, the more resolute the Lions of the Emperor become.

Peerless Warrior.name: PEERLESS WARRIOR
Peerless Warrior.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Peerless Warrior.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
Peerless Warrior.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
Peerless Warrior.flavour: With every strike, the Lions of the Emperor prove themselves the masters of single combat, even when engaging the mightiest foes.

Unleash the Lions.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
Unleash the Lions.target: One ALLARUS CUSTODIANS or AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
Unleash the Lions.effect: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.
Unleash the Lions.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One ALLARUS CUSTODIANS or AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit from your army that is on the battlefield.

EFFECT: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.
Unleash the Lions.flavour: Heroic bands of Terminator-armoured Custodians engage entire armies in unrelenting battle.

Manoeuvre and Fire.name: MANOEUVRE AND FIRE
Manoeuvre and Fire.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.
Manoeuvre and Fire.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Manoeuvre and Fire.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Manoeuvre and Fire.flavour: The Adeptus Custodes are unrelenting in their advance, laying down punishing fire even as they manoeuvre to new positions.

Swift as the Eagle.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
Swift as the Eagle.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
Swift as the Eagle.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Swift as the Eagle.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Swift as the Eagle.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
Swift as the Eagle.flavour: Although every Custodian is devastatingly fast on the battlefield, with preternatural reactions to match, the Lions of the Emperor are outstanding even among their peers.

enhancements.name: Superior Creation
enhancements.text: **^^Adeptus Custodes Infantry^^** model only. The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set the bearer back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, with its full wounds remaining.

enhancements.name: Praesidius
enhancements.text: The bearer has the Lone Operative and Stealth abilities.

enhancements.name: Fierce Conqueror
enhancements.text: At the start of the Fight phase, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer for every 5 enemy models within 6" of the bearer (rounding  down).

enhancements.name: Admonimortis
enhancements.text: **^^Shield‑Captain^^** model only. Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 3, and improve the Armour Penetration and Damage characteristics of those weapons by  1.

rule.name: Revered Companions
rule.text:
^^**Anathema Psykana^^** units from your army gain the following ability:
**Null Aegis (Aura)**: While an ^^**Adeptus Custodes^^** unit is within 6" of this unit, models in that unit have the Feel No Pain 5+ ability against Psychic Attacks and mortal wounds.


All other **^^Adeptus Custodes**^^ units from your army gain the following ability:
**Deadly Unity (Aura)**: While an **^Anathema Psykana^^** unit is within 6" of this unit, each time a model in that ^^**Anathema Psykana^^** unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

Hunt As One.name: HUNT AS ONE
Hunt As One.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
Hunt As One.effect: Until the end of the turn, your units are eilgible to shoot and/or declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.
Hunt As One.restrictions: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
Hunt As One.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your units are eilgible to shoot and/or declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
Hunt As One.flavour: Custodians and Null Maidens cover one another seamlessly as they manoeuvre to corner their prey.

Talons Interlocked.name: TALONS INTERLOCKED
Talons Interlocked.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, and one enemy unit that is an eligible target for all of those units.
Talons Interlocked.effect: Until the end of the phase, your units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of your units makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
Talons Interlocked.restrictions: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
Talons Interlocked.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, and one enemy unit that is an eligible target for all of those units.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of your units makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
Talons Interlocked.flavour: With practiced ease, the Talons of the Emperor establish vicious crossfires to cut the foe apart.

Empyric Severance.name: EMPYRIC SEVERANCE
Empyric Severance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Empyric Severance.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit within 6" of that ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
Empyric Severance.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.
Empyric Severance.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit within 6" of that ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.
Empyric Severance.flavour: Null Maidens quash the manifestations of witches.

Emperor's Executioners.name: EMPEROR’S EXECUTIONERS
Emperor's Executioners.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
Emperor's Executioners.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll.
Emperor's Executioners.restrictions: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
Emperor's Executioners.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
Emperor's Executioners.flavour: The Talons of the Emperor tear apart their prey.

Taloned Pincer.name: TALONED PINCER
Taloned Pincer.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
Taloned Pincer.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit.
Taloned Pincer.effect: Your units can make a Normal move of up to 6".
Taloned Pincer.restrictions: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
Taloned Pincer.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your units can make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
Taloned Pincer.flavour: Every move the enemy makes only sees them fall.

Shield of Honour.name: SHIELD OF HONOUR
Shield of Honour.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Shield of Honour.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one other friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within 6" of that ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit.
Shield of Honour.effect: Until the end of the phase, any attack that targets your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit must instead target your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless it is not an eligible target).
Shield of Honour.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one other friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within 6" of that ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, any attack that targets your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit must instead target your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless it is not an eligible target).
Shield of Honour.flavour: It is second nature for Custodes to place themselves between their comrades and potential peril.

enhancements.name: Radiant Mantle
enhancements.text: Each time an attack targets the bearer's unit, if the attacking model is within 12", subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Aegis Projector
enhancements.text: Once per turn, the first time a saving throw is failed for the bearer's unit, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0.

enhancements.name: Gift of Terran Artifice
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer makes a melee attack, add 1 to the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Champion of the Imperium
enhancements.text: The range of the bearer’s Null Aegis or Deadly Unity ability is increased to 9".

rule.name: Assemblage of Might
rule.text: At the start of your Command phase, select one unit from your opponent’s army. Until the start of your next Command phase, each time a model in an ^^**Adeptus Custodes Character^^** unit from your army makes an attack that targets that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Slayer of Champions.name: SLAYER OF CHAMPIONS
Slayer of Champions.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that has just destroyed the unit you selected at the start of your Command phase as the target of your Assemblage of Might ability.
Slayer of Champions.effect: Select one enemy unit on the battlefield Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army makes an attack that target that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll In addition, if the destroyed unit was a CHARACTER unit, gain 1CP.
Slayer of Champions.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that has just destroyed the unit you selected at the start of your Command phase as the target of your Assemblage of Might ability.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit on the battlefield Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army makes an attack that target that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll In addition, if the destroyed unit was a CHARACTER unit, gain 1CP.
Slayer of Champions.flavour: Whatfoe can withstand a warrior who has so tested the defences of the Throneworld itself?

Superhuman Reserves.name: SUPERHUMAN RESERVES
Superhuman Reserves.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet or from an Enhancement that says it can only be used Once per battle.
Superhuman Reserves.effect: Your model can use its Once per battle’ ability one additional time during this battle (but not in the same phase).
Superhuman Reserves.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.
Superhuman Reserves.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet or from an Enhancement that says it can only be used Once per battle.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model.

EFFECT: Your model can use its Once per battle’ ability one additional time during this battle (but not in the same phase).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.
Superhuman Reserves.flavour: With practiced ease, the Talons of the Emperor establish vicious crossfires to cut the foe apart.

The Emperor's Auspice.name: THE EMPEROR’S AUSPICE
The Emperor's Auspice.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
The Emperor's Auspice.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
The Emperor's Auspice.effect: Until the end of the phase, CHARACTER models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
The Emperor's Auspice.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, CHARACTER models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
The Emperor's Auspice.flavour: In an age plagued by monsters, when primordial horrors from the darkest void circle Humanity's dying light, still the Adeptus Custodes stand strong.

Earning of a Name.name: EARNING OF A NAME
Earning of a Name.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
Earning of a Name.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CHARACTER model in either of your units makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Earning of a Name.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a CHARACTER model in either of your units makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
Earning of a Name.flavour: To lay low the greatest and most terrible monsters and heretics is to earn new names for a Custodian's mighty tally.

Vigil Unending.name: VIGIL UNENDING
Vigil Unending.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed and has not fought this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
Vigil Unending.effect: Do not remove your destroyed model from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
Vigil Unending.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed and has not fought this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Do not remove your destroyed model from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
Vigil Unending.flavour: The Custodes do not yield while their duty remains unfulfilled.

Shoulder the Mantle.name: SHOULDER THE MANTLE
Shoulder the Mantle.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
Shoulder the Mantle.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that is not leading a unit.
Shoulder the Mantle.effect: Select one friendly unit (excluding Battle-shocked and Attached units) within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model that it could lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet). Your model attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
Shoulder the Mantle.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that is not leading a unit.

EFFECT: Select one friendly unit (excluding Battle-shocked and Attached units) within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model that it could lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet). Your model attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
Shoulder the Mantle.flavour: The greatest Custodians know when it is both their duty and their right to command their comrades.

enhancements.name: Blade Imperator
enhancements.text: Each time the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, select one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer and roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Once per battle, when the bearer's unit ends a Charge move, all enemy units within 6" of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Inspirational Exemplar
enhancements.text: The bearer has a Leadership characteristic of 5+. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, you can select one friendly **^^Adeptus Custodes^^** unit that is Battle-shocked and within 12" of the bearer: that unit is no longer Battle-shocked.

enhancements.name: Veiled Blade
enhancements.text: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the bearer's melee weapons. Once per battle, at the start of any Command phase, triple the bearer's Objective Control characteristic until the end of the turn.

enhancements.name: Martial Philosopher
enhancements.text: Once per battle, in your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of the bearer, if the bearer's unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

rule.name: Martial Mastery
rule.text:
At the start of the battle round, you can select one of the bullet points below. If you do, until the start of the next battle round, that bullet point’s effects apply.

- Each time an ^^**Adeptus Custodes^^** model from your army with the Martial Ka'tah ability makes a melee attack, a successful unmodified attack roll of 5+ scores a Critical Hit.
- Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by ^^**Adeptus Custodes^^** models from your army with the Martial Ka'tah ability by 1.

Arcane Genetic Alchemy.name: ARCANE GENETIC ALCHEMY
Arcane Genetic Alchemy.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound has been allocated to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model from your army(excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA models).
Arcane Genetic Alchemy.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
Arcane Genetic Alchemy.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a mortal wound has been allocated to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model from your army(excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA models).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES model’s unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
Arcane Genetic Alchemy.flavour: The Adeptus Custodes are individually engineered on a molecular level using secrets of genetic alchemy that render them virtual demigods in battle.

Avenge the Fallen.name: AVENGE THE FALLEN
Avenge the Fallen.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is below its Starting Strength.
Avenge the Fallen.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Below Half-strength, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those melee weapons instead.
Avenge the Fallen.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is below its Starting Strength.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Below Half-strength, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those melee weapons instead.
Avenge the Fallen.flavour: The loss of a single Talon of the Emperor is commemorated by the tolling of the Bell of Lost Souls on Terra, and by their comrades’ bloody vengeance on the battlefield.

Unwavering Sentinels.name: UNWAVERING SENTINELS
Unwavering Sentinels.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Unwavering Sentinels.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is within range of an objective marker you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Unwavering Sentinels.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Unwavering Sentinels.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is within range of an objective marker you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Unwavering Sentinels.flavour: Once the Custodians have laid claim to a location, they defend it with incredible tenacity and skill.

Multipotentiality.name: MULTIPOTENTIALITY
Multipotentiality.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.
Multipotentiality.effect: Until the end of your turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Multipotentiality.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of your turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Multipotentiality.flavour: So widely skilled and studied are the Custodians that, whatever situation they find themselves in, they have the martial wisdom to prevail.

Vigilance Eternal.name: VIGILANCE ETERNAL
Vigilance Eternal.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES BATTLELINE unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within range of an objective marker you control.
Vigilance Eternal.effect: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
Vigilance Eternal.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES BATTLELINE unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
Vigilance Eternal.flavour: Simply because the Adeptus Custodes do not stand sentinel over a strategic location or asset, does not mean that it - or any who would threaten it - escapes their gaze.

Archeotech Munitions.name: ARCHEOTECH MUNITIONS
Archeotech Munitions.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Archeotech Munitions.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
Archeotech Munitions.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
Archeotech Munitions.flavour: The Shield Hosts have access to stockpiles of ancient and incredibly rare weaponry and ammunition.

enhancements.name: Castellan's Mark
enhancements.text: After both players have deployed their armies, you can select up to two **ADEPTUS CUSTODES** units from your army (excluding **ANATHEMA PSYKANA** units) and redeploy all of those units. When doing so, any of those units can be placed into Strategic Reserves, regardless of how  any units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Panoptispex
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability.

enhancements.name: From the Hall of Armouries
enhancements.text: Add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons.

enhancements.name: Auric Mantle
enhancements.text: **^^Shield-Captain^^** or **^^Blade Champion^^** model only. Add 2 to the bearer's Wounds characteristic.

rule.name: Creeping Dread (Aura)
rule.text: In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, if an enemy unit that is either a ^^**Psyker^^** unit or below its Starting Strength is within 12" of one or more ^^**Anathema Psykana^^** models from your army, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test. If that unit is below Half-strength, it must subtract 1 from its Battle-shock test this phase instead.

Desperation's Price.name: DESPERATION’S PRICE
Desperation's Price.when: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.
Desperation's Price.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.
Desperation's Price.effect: That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.
Desperation's Price.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.
Desperation's Price.flavour: To overcome the Null Maidens’ aura, enemy psykers overstretch themselves with horrible consequences.

Witch Hunters.name: WITCH HUNTERS
Witch Hunters.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
Witch Hunters.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
Witch Hunters.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.
Witch Hunters.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.
Witch Hunters.flavour: Null Maidens train to slay psykers with swift martial efficiency, for they know their prey have many weapons beyond just their powers and must not be allowed time or opportunity to employ them.

Anathema Blademastery.name: ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY
Anathema Blademastery.target: One VIGILATORS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
Anathema Blademastery.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Anathema Blademastery.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One VIGILATORS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
Anathema Blademastery.flavour: The Vigilators train tirelessly in the art of the swift, beheading strike, with a particular emphasis on the swift elimination of enemy witches.

Psy-Chaff Volley.name: PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY
Psy-Chaff Volley.target: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has just shot.
Psy-Chaff Volley.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model makes an attack against that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Psy-Chaff Volley.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has just shot.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model makes an attack against that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
Psy-Chaff Volley.flavour: Prosecutors can fire psy-chaff bolts whose esoteric emissions weaken those targets not slain outright.

Purgation Sweep.name: PURGATION SWEEP
Purgation Sweep.target: One WITCHSEEKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Purgation Sweep.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.
Purgation Sweep.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One WITCHSEEKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.
Purgation Sweep.flavour: Witchseekers know their role in combat is to spread indiscriminate carnage through the foe’s ranks.

Psychic Abominations.name: PSYCHIC ABOMINATIONS
Psychic Abominations.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Psychic Abominations.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Psychic Abominations.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only select your unit as a target of a ranged attack if they are within 12".
Psychic Abominations.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only select your unit as a target of a ranged attack if they are within 12".
Psychic Abominations.flavour: Enemies must overcome disorienting waves of revulsion in order to even focus upon Null Maidens.

enhancements.name: Raptor Blade
enhancements.text: Add 1 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons. While the bearer is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy **^^Psyker^^** units that are Battle-shocked, add 2 to the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of the bearer's melee weapons instead.

enhancements.name: Enhanced Voidsheen Cloak
enhancements.text: Each time an attack is allocated to the bearer, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack. If that attack was made by a **^^Psyker^^** or Battle-shocked model, change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 1 instead.

enhancements.name: Huntress' Eye
enhancements.text: In your Command phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.text: While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll. If that attack targeted an enemy **^^Psyker^^** unit, add 1 to the Wound roll as well.

rule.name: Auric Armour
rule.text:
■ While an ^^**Adeptus Custodes Vehicle^^** unit from your army is at Starting Strength, unless that unit is an ^^**Aircraft^^** or it is Battle‑shocked, add 2 to the Objective Control characteristic of models in that unit.

■ While an ^^**Adeptus Custodes Vehicle^^** unit from your army is below Starting Strength, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1.

■ While an ^^**Adeptus Custodes Vehicle^^** unit from your army is Below Half‑strength, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1 and re‑roll a Wound roll of 1.

rule.name: Moritoi Ancients
rule.text: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of models in ^^**Adeptus Custodes Walker^^** units from your army and add 1 to  Advance and Charge rolls made for such units.

Flawless Construction.name: FLAWLESS CONSTRUCTION
Flawless Construction.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Flawless Construction.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Flawless Construction.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Flawless Construction.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Flawless Construction.flavour: The vehicles of the Adeptus Custodes are the finest examples of their kind. Their expertly wrought armoured forms contain ancient and esoteric technology, including auto-repair subroutines and reactive field generators.

Emperor's Vengeance.name: EMPEROR’S VENGEANCE
Emperor's Vengeance.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Emperor's Vengeance.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Emperor's Vengeance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the WALKER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is assumed to have 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
Emperor's Vengeance.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the WALKER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is assumed to have 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
Emperor's Vengeance.flavour: Even as death’s cold embrace falls upon them, Custodians vent the last of their wrath upon the foe.

Wrathful Advance.name: WRATHFUL ADVANCE
Wrathful Advance.when: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.
Wrathful Advance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".
Wrathful Advance.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".
Wrathful Advance.flavour: The golden-armoured onslaught smashes through the enemy line, trapping the foe and preventing their escape.

Unstoppable.name: UNSTOPPABLE
Unstoppable.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
Unstoppable.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit from your army.
Unstoppable.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
Unstoppable.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
Unstoppable.flavour: Armoured in adamantine and possessed of furious machine spirits, the vehicles of the Adeptus Custodes are almost impossible to stop in their tracks.

Relentless Persecution.name: RELENTLESS PERSECUTION
Relentless Persecution.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.
Relentless Persecution.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the WALKER keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
Relentless Persecution.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the WALKER keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
Relentless Persecution.flavour: Custodians coax wrathful fury from their war engines’ machine spirits to hunt down and eliminate their foes at speed.

Punishment Inescapable.name: PUNISHMENT INESCAPABLE
Punishment Inescapable.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Punishment Inescapable.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
Punishment Inescapable.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
Punishment Inescapable.flavour: The Ten Thousand are relentless in pursuing the Emperor’s foes and thorough in their annihilation. No armour, sorcery or hiding place can shield an enemy from their wrath.

enhancements.name: Honoured Fallen (Aura)
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE model only. While a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit is within 6" of the bearer, each time a model in that unit makes  an attack, re‑roll a Hit roll of 1.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Talisman
enhancements.text: **^^Adeptus Custodes^^** model only. Improve the Attacks, Strength and Damage characteristics of melee weapons equipped by the bearer by 1.

enhancements.name: Veteran of the Kataphraktoi
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED model only. In your Command phase, select one ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit within 6" of the bearer. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

rule.name: The Hammer Falls
rule.text:
If a friendly **ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR** unit made an **ingress move** this turn, that unit can re‑roll **charge rolls**. 


This detachment has the LIONS tag and cannot be taken with another LIONS detachment.

Hardened Resolve.name: HARDENED RESOLVE
Hardened Resolve.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATORADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
Hardened Resolve.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATORADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 T.
Hardened Resolve.flavour: Steeling their souls and bracing their indomitable armour, heavily girded Custodians will cleave to their duty and reject attempts to cut them down.

Unleash the Lions.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
Unleash the Lions.target: One friendly ALLARUS CUSTODIANS/AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit that is on the battlefield.
Unleash the Lions.effect: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a starting strength of 1.
Unleash the Lions.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One friendly ALLARUS CUSTODIANS/AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit that is on the battlefield.

EFFECT: Your unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a starting strength of 1.
Unleash the Lions.flavour: Heroic bands of Terminator‑armoured Custodians engage entire armies in unrelenting battle.

Electroexorcist Saturation.name: ELECTROEXORCIST SATURATION
Electroexorcist Saturation.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.
Electroexorcist Saturation.effect: Your unit’s Ballistus Grenade Launcher weapons have D3+3 A.
Electroexorcist Saturation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Ballistus Grenade Launcher weapons have D3+3 A.
Electroexorcist Saturation.flavour: A concussive barrage of specialist grenades enables Allarus Custodians to maximise the destructive potential of their armmounted launchers against their massed enemies.

enhancements.name: Efficient Aggression
enhancements.text: (Once per turn, per army) In your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot, if this unit lost a wound as a result of those attacks, this unit can make a **surge move** of up to D6+1".

enhancements.name: Mnemo-locked Shrine Cipher
enhancements.text: In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an **ingress move**.

rule.name: Skin-crawling Disorientation
rule.text:
- When a friendly **ANATHEMA PSYKANA** unit is selected to make an **advance move**, that **advance move** does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to start an action**.
- Friendly **ANATHEMA PSYKANA** units have the following ability: 
**Ceaseless Vigilance**: In your Shooting phase, this unit can select one **visible** enemy unit within 12". That enemy unit is nulled: 
- While a unit is nulled, that unit has +3" **detection range**.

Deathsong Scythes.name: DEATHSONG SCYTHES
Deathsong Scythes.when: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATORS unit is selected to fight.
Deathsong Scythes.effect:
- Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

- Your unit’s melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit have +1 A.
Deathsong Scythes.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATORS unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That VIGILATORS unit.

EFFECT:

- Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

- Your unit’s melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit have +1 A.
Deathsong Scythes.flavour: After stalking their sorcerous prey in silence, the charge of the Vigilators is accompanied by a keening song of death emitted by their scything greatblades as they are swept in eviscerating arcs.

Umbral Prosecution.name: UMBRAL PROSECUTION
Umbral Prosecution.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTORS unit is selected to shoot.
Umbral Prosecution.effect:
Your unit’s Boltgun weapons have:

- [RAPID FIRE 2].

- +1 AP.
Umbral Prosecution.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTORS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That PROSECUTORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Boltgun weapons have:

- [RAPID FIRE 2].

- +1 AP.
Umbral Prosecution.flavour: When they have cornered their quarry at close range, Prosecutors fire their Umbra-pattern bolters in rapid bursts that sow strings of armour-shredding shots amongst the enemy.

Synchronised Inferno.name: SYNCHRONISED INFERNO
Synchronised Inferno.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKERS unit is selected to shoot.
Synchronised Inferno.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKERS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That WITCHSEEKERS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s [TORRENT] ranged attacks have [BLAST 1].
Synchronised Inferno.flavour: Coordinating through a rapid exchange of Thoughtmark, Witchseekers unleash a flesh-melting inferno of all-consuming promethium from their flamers.

enhancements.name: Encircling Hunter
enhancements.text: When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly **ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY** units. When doing so, you can set those units up in **strategic reserves**, regardless of how many units are already in **strategic reserves**.

enhancements.name: Psyk-out Grenades
enhancements.text:
- This unit has EXPLOSIVES. 
- When you target this unit with the Explosives stratagem, if you select an enemy PSYKER unit, you can re‑roll rolls to determine whether that enemy unit suffers a mortal wound.

rule.name: March of the Honoured Dead
rule.text:
Friendly **ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER** units: 
- Have +2" **M**. 
- Have +1 to **advance rolls** and **charge rolls**.

Flawless Construction.name: FLAWLESS CONSTRUCTION
Flawless Construction.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit.
Flawless Construction.effect: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Flawless Construction.text:

EFFECT: Attacks that target your unit with a S greater than your unit’s T have -1 to wound rolls.
Flawless Construction.flavour: Adeptus Custodes Dreadnoughts possess expertly wrought armoured forms that contain ancient and esoteric technology, including auto‑repair subroutines and reactive field generators.

Unstoppable Advance.name: UNSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
Unstoppable Advance.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit is selected to move.
Unstoppable Advance.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.
Unstoppable Advance.flavour: Even the most formidable obstacles give way to the ancient warriors of the Moritoi, ruptured and trampled underfoot or barged aside with howl of empowered servos.

Prioritised Eradication.name: PRIORITISED ERADICATION
Prioritised Eradication.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to shoot.
Prioritised Eradication.effect:
Your unit’s:

- Arachnus Storm Cannon weapons have [RAPID FIRE 6].

- Iliastus Accelerator Culverin weapons have [RAPID FIRE 2].
Prioritised Eradication.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s:

- Arachnus Storm Cannon weapons have [RAPID FIRE 6].

- Iliastus Accelerator Culverin weapons have [RAPID FIRE 2].
Prioritised Eradication.flavour: When lauded Telemon pilots turn their pitiless optics upon a proximal threat, the storm of accelerated firepower that ensues leaves naught but smoking ruin.
