enhancements.text:
ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit only. This unit’s attacks can:

- Re-roll hit rolls of 1.

- Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

enhancements.name: - Auramite SarcophagusUPGRADE
enhancements.text: ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit only. When you target this unit with the Crushing Impact stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

rule.name: Focused Ka’tah
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Martial Ka’tah ability retain that ability and gain this one.

However, you no longer select a Ka’tah Stance each time a unit with the Martial Ka’tah ability is selected to fight. Instead, at the start of the Fight phase, you can select one Ka’tah Stance. Until the end of the phase, the selected Stance is active for your army and units from your army with the Martial Ka’tah ability gain the relevant ability. Each Ka’tah Stance can only be selected once per battle.

rule.name: Overwhelming Magnificence
rule.text: While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one or more ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army, subtract 1 from the Objective Control characteristic of models in that enemy unit.

Inescapable Vengeance.name: INESCAPABLE VENGEANCE
Inescapable Vengeance.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.
Inescapable Vengeance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can ignore Walls and other models for the purposes of determining which enemy units are visible to its own.
Inescapable Vengeance.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can ignore Walls and other models for the purposes of determining which enemy units are visible to its own.
Inescapable Vengeance.flavour: The incredible sensory acuity of the Custodians' wargear coupled with their superhuman senses means no foe can hide from them.

Breaching Behemoths.name: BREACHING BEHEMOTHS
Breaching Behemoths.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.
Breaching Behemoths.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in your unit can move through other models as if they were not there. In addition, any Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed.
Breaching Behemoths.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in your unit can move through other models as if they were not there. In addition, any Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed.
Breaching Behemoths.flavour: When unleashed aboard an enemy voidship, Custodians simply smash a path through any who stand against them by their sheer armoured might.

Artificer Rounds.name: ARTIFICER ROUNDS
Artificer Rounds.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Artificer Rounds.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding ballistus grenade launchers) have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting units within 6".
Artificer Rounds.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding ballistus grenade launchers) have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting units within 6".
Artificer Rounds.flavour: These hand-crafted bolt shells are made to fragment with particular ferocity, making them ideal for boarding actions.

Auric Storm.name: AURIC STORM
Auric Storm.when: Your Charge phase, just after an ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
Auric Storm.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
Auric Storm.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after an ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
Auric Storm.flavour: Even the boldest foes falter before the sudden and unstoppable onslaught of the Allarus Terminators.

enhancements.name: Voidstrider
enhancements.text: Add 2" to the bearer’s Move characteristic.

enhancements.name: Mantle of the Emissary
enhancements.text: The bearer has an Objective Control characteristic of 5.

rule.name: Focused Ka’tah
rule.text:
Units from your army with the Martial Ka’tah ability retain that ability and gain this one.

However, you no longer select a Ka’tah Stance each time a unit with the Martial Ka’tah ability is selected to fight. Instead, at the start of the Fight phase, you can select one Ka’tah Stance. Until the end of the phase, the selected Stance is active for your army and units from your army with the Martial Ka’tah ability gain the relevant ability. Each Ka’tah Stance can only be selected once per battle.

rule.name: Priority Quarry
rule.text: At the start of the first battle round, you can select up to two enemy units to be your army’s quarry, one of which must be your opponents WARLORD. Each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army makes an attack that targets one of your army’s quarries, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. Each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army declares a charge, it can include one or more of your army’s quarries as targets of that charge, even if they are not visible to it.

Blades of the Vigilators.name: BLADES OF THE VIGILATORS
Blades of the Vigilators.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Blades of the Vigilators.target: One VIGILATORS, ALEYA or KNIGHT-CENTURA equipped with an executioner greatblade unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Blades of the Vigilators.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Blades of the Vigilators.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One VIGILATORS, ALEYA or KNIGHT-CENTURA equipped with an executioner greatblade unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
Blades of the Vigilators.flavour: Though intended for lopping the heads from witches, the Vigilators' long blades also allow for skilful parrying of incoming attacks.

Focused Fear.name: FOCUSED FEAR
Focused Fear.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
Focused Fear.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
Focused Fear.effect: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Focused Fear.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
Focused Fear.flavour: Fighting in the confines of a voidship heightens the fearful aura of the Sisters of Silence, fouling their foes'aim and weakening their sword arms.

Cornered Prey.name: CORNERED PREY
Cornered Prey.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army Falls Back.
Cornered Prey.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Cornered Prey.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
Cornered Prey.flavour: Once they have their quarry trapped within a section of the voidship, the Silent Sisters relentlessly run them to ground.

Punishment of the Prosecutors.name: PUNISHMENT OF THE PROSECUTORS
Punishment of the Prosecutors.target: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
Punishment of the Prosecutors.effect: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by an additional 1.
Punishment of the Prosecutors.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by an additional 1.
Punishment of the Prosecutors.flavour: The Prosecutors cut down without mercy all who dare stand between the Silent Sisters and their prey.

enhancements.name: The Vratine Aquila (Aura)
enhancements.text: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. While a friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit is within 3" of the bearer, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

enhancements.name: Sinister Presence (Aura)
enhancements.text: ANATHEMA PSYKANA model only. While an enemy unit is within 6" of the bearer (when measuring this distance, Walls and closed Hatchways are ignored), that unit cannot Seize objective markers and, in your opponent’s Command phase, that unit must take a Battle-shock lest. This Enhancement cannot cause a unit to take two Battle-shock tests in the same phase.

huntasone.name: HUNT AS ONE
huntasone.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
huntasone.effect: Until the end of the turn, your units are eilgible to shoot and/or declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.
huntasone.restrictions: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
huntasone.text:
WHEN: Start of your Movement phase.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your units are eilgible to shoot and/or declare a charge in a turn in which they Fell Back.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
huntasone.flavour: Custodians and Null Maidens cover one another seamlessly as they manoeuvre to corner their prey.

talonsinterlocked.name: TALONS INTERLOCKED
talonsinterlocked.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, and one enemy unit that is an eligible target for all of those units.
talonsinterlocked.effect: Until the end of the phase, your units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of your units makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.
talonsinterlocked.restrictions: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
talonsinterlocked.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY units from your army, and one enemy unit that is an eligible target for all of those units.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your units can only target that enemy unit, but each time a model in one of your units makes a ranged attack, improve the Strength and Armour Penetration characteristics of that attack by 1.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
talonsinterlocked.flavour: With practiced ease, the Talons of the Emperor establish vicious crossfires to cut the foe apart.

empyricseverance.name: EMPYRIC SEVERANCE
empyricseverance.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
empyricseverance.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit within 6" of that ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.
empyricseverance.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.
empyricseverance.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit within 6" of that ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic attacks and mortal wounds.
empyricseverance.flavour: Null Maidens quash the manifestations of witches.

emperorsexecutioners.name: EMPEROR’S EXECUTIONERS
emperorsexecutioners.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.
emperorsexecutioners.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll.
emperorsexecutioners.restrictions: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
emperorsexecutioners.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in one of your units targets an enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength, add 1 to the Wound roll.

RESTRICTIONS: You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
emperorsexecutioners.flavour: The Talons of the Emperor tear apart their prey.

talonedpincer.name: TALONED PINCER
talonedpincer.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
talonedpincer.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit.
talonedpincer.effect: Your units can make a Normal move of up to 6".
talonedpincer.restrictions: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
talonedpincer.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES units from your army that are within 8" of that enemy unit.

EFFECT: Your units can make a Normal move of up to 6".

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot select units that are within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. You can only select two units if one (and only one) of them is an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit and both are within 6" of each other.
talonedpincer.flavour: Every move the enemy makes only sees them fall.

shieldofhonour.name: SHIELD OF HONOUR
shieldofhonour.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
shieldofhonour.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one other friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within 6" of that ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit.
shieldofhonour.effect: Until the end of the phase, any attack that targets your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit must instead target your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless it is not an eligible target).
shieldofhonour.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks, and one other friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within 6" of that ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, any attack that targets your ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit must instead target your other ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit (unless it is not an eligible target).
shieldofhonour.flavour: It is second nature for Custodes to place themselves between their comrades and potential peril.

arcanegeneticalchemy.name: ARCANE GENETIC ALCHEMY
arcanegeneticalchemy.when: Any phase, just after a mortal wound has been allocated to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model from your army(excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA models).
arcanegeneticalchemy.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
arcanegeneticalchemy.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after a mortal wound has been allocated to an ADEPTUS CUSTODES model from your army(excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA models).

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES model’s unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against mortal wounds.
arcanegeneticalchemy.flavour: The Adeptus Custodes are individually engineered on a molecular level using secrets of genetic alchemy that render them virtual demigods in battle.

avengethefallen.name: AVENGE THE FALLEN
avengethefallen.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is below its Starting Strength.
avengethefallen.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Below Half-strength, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those melee weapons instead.
avengethefallen.text:
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is below its Starting Strength.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. If your unit is Below Half-strength, until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of those melee weapons instead.
avengethefallen.flavour: The loss of a single Talon of the Emperor is commemorated by the tolling of the Bell of Lost Souls on Terra, and by their comrades’ bloody vengeance on the battlefield.

unwaveringsentinels.name: UNWAVERING SENTINELS
unwaveringsentinels.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
unwaveringsentinels.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is within range of an objective marker you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
unwaveringsentinels.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
unwaveringsentinels.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES INFANTRY unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that is within range of an objective marker you control and that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
unwaveringsentinels.flavour: Once the Custodians have laid claim to a location, they defend it with incredible tenacity and skill.

multipotentiality.name: MULTIPOTENTIALITY
multipotentiality.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.
multipotentiality.effect: Until the end of your turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
multipotentiality.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that Fell Back this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of your turn, that unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
multipotentiality.flavour: So widely skilled and studied are the Custodians that, whatever situation they find themselves in, they have the martial wisdom to prevail.

vigilanceeternal.name: VIGILANCE ETERNAL
vigilanceeternal.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES BATTLELINE unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within range of an objective marker you control.
vigilanceeternal.effect: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
vigilanceeternal.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES BATTLELINE unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) within range of an objective marker you control.

EFFECT: That objective marker remains under your control even if you have no models within range of it, until your opponent controls it at the start or end of any turn.
vigilanceeternal.flavour: Simply because the Adeptus Custodes do not stand sentinel over a strategic location or asset, does not mean that it - or any who would threaten it - escapes their gaze.

archeotechmunitions.name: ARCHEOTECH MUNITIONS
archeotechmunitions.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
archeotechmunitions.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
archeotechmunitions.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability.
archeotechmunitions.flavour: The Shield Hosts have access to stockpiles of ancient and incredibly rare weaponry and ammunition.

desperationsprice.name: DESPERATION’S PRICE
desperationsprice.when: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.
desperationsprice.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.
desperationsprice.effect: That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.
desperationsprice.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an enemy PSYKER unit has either finished using a Psychic ability that targets a unit, or finished making Psychic Attacks.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army within 18" of that enemy PSYKER unit.

EFFECT: That enemy PSYKER unit must take a Leadership test If the test is passed, that PSYKER unit is Battle-shocked; if the test is failed that PSYKER unit suffers 3 mortal wounds and is Battle-shocked.
desperationsprice.flavour: To overcome the Null Maidens’ aura, enemy psykers overstretch themselves with horrible consequences.

witchhunters.name: WITCH HUNTERS
witchhunters.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
witchhunters.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.
witchhunters.effect: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.
witchhunters.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot or fight this phase.

EFFECT: Select either the [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability. Until the end of the phase, weapons equipped by models in your unit have the selected ability, but models in your unit can only target PSYKER units with their attacks.
witchhunters.flavour: Null Maidens train to slay psykers with swift martial efficiency, for they know their prey have many weapons beyond just their powers and must not be allowed time or opportunity to employ them.

anathemablademastery.name: ANATHEMA BLADEMASTERY
anathemablademastery.target: One VIGILATORS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
anathemablademastery.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
anathemablademastery.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One VIGILATORS unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a melee attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll If the target of that attack is Battle-shocked or a PSYKER, you can re-roll the Wound roll as well.
anathemablademastery.flavour: The Vigilators train tirelessly in the art of the swift, beheading strike, with a particular emphasis on the swift elimination of enemy witches.

psychaffvolley.name: PSY-CHAFF VOLLEY
psychaffvolley.target: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has just shot.
psychaffvolley.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model makes an attack against that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
psychaffvolley.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has just shot.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the start of your next turn, while your unit is on the battlefield, that enemy unit is prosecuted. While a unit is prosecuted, each time an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model makes an attack against that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. While a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit is prosecuted, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
psychaffvolley.flavour: Prosecutors can fire psy-chaff bolts whose esoteric emissions weaken those targets not slain outright.

purgationsweep.name: PURGATION SWEEP
purgationsweep.target: One WITCHSEEKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
purgationsweep.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.
purgationsweep.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One WITCHSEEKERS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Torrent weapons equipped by models in your unit. If such a weapon targets a PSYKER or Battle-shocked unit this phase, add 2 to its Attacks characteristic instead.
purgationsweep.flavour: Witchseekers know their role in combat is to spread indiscriminate carnage through the foe’s ranks.

psychicabominations.name: PSYCHIC ABOMINATIONS
psychicabominations.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
psychicabominations.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
psychicabominations.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only select your unit as a target of a ranged attack if they are within 12".
psychicabominations.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA INFANTRY unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and Battle-shocked and PSYKER models can only select your unit as a target of a ranged attack if they are within 12".
psychicabominations.flavour: Enemies must overcome disorienting waves of revulsion in order to even focus upon Null Maidens.

slayerofchampions.name: SLAYER OF CHAMPIONS
slayerofchampions.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that has just destroyed the unit you selected at the start of your Command phase as the target of your Assemblage of Might ability.
slayerofchampions.effect: Select one enemy unit on the battlefield Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army makes an attack that target that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll In addition, if the destroyed unit was a CHARACTER unit, gain 1CP.
slayerofchampions.text:
WHEN: Any phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that has just destroyed the unit you selected at the start of your Command phase as the target of your Assemblage of Might ability.

EFFECT: Select one enemy unit on the battlefield Until the start of your next Command phase, each time an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army makes an attack that target that enemy unit, add 1 to the Wound roll In addition, if the destroyed unit was a CHARACTER unit, gain 1CP.
slayerofchampions.flavour: Whatfoe can withstand a warrior who has so tested the defences of the Throneworld itself?

superhumanreserves.name: SUPERHUMAN RESERVES
superhumanreserves.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet or from an Enhancement that says it can only be used Once per battle.
superhumanreserves.effect: Your model can use its Once per battle’ ability one additional time during this battle (but not in the same phase).
superhumanreserves.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.
superhumanreserves.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet or from an Enhancement that says it can only be used Once per battle.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WARLORD model.

EFFECT: Your model can use its Once per battle’ ability one additional time during this battle (but not in the same phase).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem more than once per battle.
superhumanreserves.flavour: With practiced ease, the Talons of the Emperor establish vicious crossfires to cut the foe apart.

theemperorsauspice.name: THE EMPEROR’S AUSPICE
theemperorsauspice.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
theemperorsauspice.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
theemperorsauspice.effect: Until the end of the phase, CHARACTER models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
theemperorsauspice.text:

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, CHARACTER models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability.
theemperorsauspice.flavour: In an age plagued by monsters, when primordial horrors from the darkest void circle Humanity's dying light, still the Adeptus Custodes stand strong.

earningofaname.name: EARNING OF A NAME
earningofaname.target: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.
earningofaname.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a CHARACTER model in either of your units makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
earningofaname.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: Up to two ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER units from your army that have not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a CHARACTER model in either of your units makes an attack that targets a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.
earningofaname.flavour: To lay low the greatest and most terrible monsters and heretics is to earn new names for a Custodian's mighty tally.

vigilunending.name: VIGIL UNENDING
vigilunending.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed and has not fought this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.
vigilunending.effect: Do not remove your destroyed model from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
vigilunending.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed and has not fought this phase. You can use this Stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed.

EFFECT: Do not remove your destroyed model from play. The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making attacks, and is then removed from play.
vigilunending.flavour: The Custodes do not yield while their duty remains unfulfilled.

shoulderthemantle.name: SHOULDER THE MANTLE
shoulderthemantle.when: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.
shoulderthemantle.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that is not leading a unit.
shoulderthemantle.effect: Select one friendly unit (excluding Battle-shocked and Attached units) within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model that it could lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet). Your model attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
shoulderthemantle.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, before the Reinforcements step.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army that is not leading a unit.

EFFECT: Select one friendly unit (excluding Battle-shocked and Attached units) within 2" horizontally and 5" vertically of your model that it could lead (as described in the Leader section of its datasheet). Your model attaches to that unit as a Leader. Change that unit’s Starting Strength accordingly.
shoulderthemantle.flavour: The greatest Custodians know when it is both their duty and their right to command their comrades.

flawlessconstruction.name: FLAWLESS CONSTRUCTION
flawlessconstruction.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
flawlessconstruction.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
flawlessconstruction.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
flawlessconstruction.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets a model in your unit, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is greater than the Toughness characteristic of your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
flawlessconstruction.flavour: The vehicles of the Adeptus Custodes are the finest examples of their kind. Their expertly wrought armoured forms contain ancient and esoteric technology, including auto-repair subroutines and reactive field generators.

emperorsvengeance.name: EMPEROR’S VENGEANCE
emperorsvengeance.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
emperorsvengeance.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
emperorsvengeance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit has the WALKER keyword. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is assumed to have 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
emperorsvengeance.text:

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

On a 4+, do not remove it from play; The destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is assumed to have 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
emperorsvengeance.flavour: Even as death’s cold embrace falls upon them, Custodians vent the last of their wrath upon the foe.

wrathfuladvance.name: WRATHFUL ADVANCE
wrathfuladvance.when: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.
wrathfuladvance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".
wrathfuladvance.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, just before an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Piles In.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in move, it can move up to D3+3" instead of up to 3".
wrathfuladvance.flavour: The golden-armoured onslaught smashes through the enemy line, trapping the foe and preventing their escape.

unstoppable.name: UNSTOPPABLE
unstoppable.when: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.
unstoppable.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit from your army.
unstoppable.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
unstoppable.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase or your Charge phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE or ADEPTUS CUSTODES MOUNTED unit from your army.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a move, it can move through terrain features.
unstoppable.flavour: Armoured in adamantine and possessed of furious machine spirits, the vehicles of the Adeptus Custodes are almost impossible to stop in their tracks.

relentlesspersecution.name: RELENTLESS PERSECUTION
relentlesspersecution.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.
relentlesspersecution.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the WALKER keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
relentlesspersecution.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit from your army Advances.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES VEHICLE unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Advanced. If your unit has the WALKER keyword, until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced instead.
relentlesspersecution.flavour: Custodians coax wrathful fury from their war engines’ machine spirits to hunt down and eliminate their foes at speed.

punishmentinescapable.name: PUNISHMENT INESCAPABLE
punishmentinescapable.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
punishmentinescapable.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
punishmentinescapable.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability, and until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes an attack, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack’s Ballistic Skill characteristic and/or any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.
punishmentinescapable.flavour: The Ten Thousand are relentless in pursuing the Emperor’s foes and thorough in their annihilation. No armour, sorcery or hiding place can shield an enemy from their wrath.

gildedchampion.name: GILDED CHAMPION
gildedchampion.when: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet that states it can only be used ‘once per battle’.
gildedchampion.effect: Your model can use that ‘once per battle’ ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase).
gildedchampion.restrictions: You cannot use this Stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.
gildedchampion.text:
WHEN: Any phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model from your army has used an ability on its datasheet that states it can only be used ‘once per battle’.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model.

EFFECT: Your model can use that ‘once per battle’ ability one additional time during the battle (but not in the same phase).

RESTRICTIONS: You cannot use this Stratagem on the same ADEPTUS CUSTODES CHARACTER model more than once per battle.
gildedchampion.flavour: The shining champions of the Adeptus Custodes are looked upon in awe by all who witness their grim arts. Their judgement is without flaw, and their tactical acumen utterly impeccable.

defianttothelast.name: DEFIANT TO THE LAST

defianttothelast.text:

On a 4+, do not remove it from play; the destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks (when doing so, it is treated as having 1 wound remaining), and is then removed from play.
defianttothelast.flavour: The harder the battle, and the heavier their losses, the more resolute the Lions of the Emperor become.

peerlesswarrior.name: PEERLESS WARRIOR
peerlesswarrior.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.
peerlesswarrior.effect: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
peerlesswarrior.text:
WHEN: Fight phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to fight this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, melee weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PRECISION] ability.
peerlesswarrior.flavour: With every strike, the Lions of the Emperor prove themselves the masters of single combat, even when engaging the mightiest foes.

unleashthelions.name: UNLEASH THE LIONS
unleashthelions.target: One ALLARUS CUSTODIANS or AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit from your army that is on the battlefield.
unleashthelions.effect: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.
unleashthelions.text:
WHEN: Your Command phase.

TARGET: One ALLARUS CUSTODIANS or AQUILON CUSTODIANS unit from your army that is on the battlefield.

EFFECT: That unit is split into separate units, each containing one model. These new units each have a Starting Strength of 1.
unleashthelions.flavour: Heroic bands of Terminator-armoured Custodians engage entire armies in unrelenting battle.

manoeuvreandfire.name: MANOEUVRE AND FIRE
manoeuvreandfire.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.
manoeuvreandfire.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
manoeuvreandfire.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army Falls Back.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
manoeuvreandfire.flavour: The Adeptus Custodes are unrelenting in their advance, laying down punishing fire even as they manoeuvre to new positions.

swiftastheeagle.name: SWIFT AS THE EAGLE
swiftastheeagle.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.
swiftastheeagle.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
swiftastheeagle.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
swiftastheeagle.text:
WHEN: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has shot.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding VEHICLE units) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6".
swiftastheeagle.flavour: Although every Custodian is devastatingly fast on the battlefield, with preternatural reactions to match, the Lions of the Emperor are outstanding even among their peers.

unstoppableadvance.name: UNSTOPPABLE ADVANCE
unstoppableadvance.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit is selected to move.
unstoppableadvance.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit is selected to move.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES WALKER unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has MOBILE.
unstoppableadvance.flavour: Even the most formidable obstacles give way to the ancient warriors of the Moritoi, ruptured and trampled underfoot or barged aside with howl of empowered servos.

prioritisederadication.name: PRIORITISED ERADICATION
prioritisederadication.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit is selected to shoot.
prioritisederadication.effect:
Your unit’s:

- Arachnus Storm Cannon weapons have [RAPID FIRE 6].

- Iliastus Accelerator Culverin weapons have [RAPID FIRE 2].
prioritisederadication.text:

TARGET: That TELEMON HEAVY DREADNOUGHT unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s:

- Arachnus Storm Cannon weapons have [RAPID FIRE 6].

- Iliastus Accelerator Culverin weapons have [RAPID FIRE 2].
prioritisederadication.flavour: When lauded Telemon pilots turn their pitiless optics upon a proximal threat, the storm of accelerated firepower that ensues leaves naught but smoking ruin.

deathsongscythes.name: DEATHSONG SCYTHES
deathsongscythes.when: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATORS unit is selected to fight.
deathsongscythes.effect:
- Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

- Your unit’s melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit have +1 A.
deathsongscythes.text:
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly VIGILATORS unit is selected to fight.

TARGET: That VIGILATORS unit.

EFFECT:

- Your unit’s melee attacks have [LANCE].

- Your unit’s melee attacks that target a PSYKER unit have +1 A.
deathsongscythes.flavour: After stalking their sorcerous prey in silence, the charge of the Vigilators is accompanied by a keening song of death emitted by their scything greatblades as they are swept in eviscerating arcs.

umbralprosecution.name: UMBRAL PROSECUTION
umbralprosecution.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTORS unit is selected to shoot.
umbralprosecution.effect:
Your unit’s Boltgun weapons have:

- [RAPID FIRE 2].

- +1 AP.
umbralprosecution.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly PROSECUTORS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That PROSECUTORS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Boltgun weapons have:

- [RAPID FIRE 2].

- +1 AP.
umbralprosecution.flavour: When they have cornered their quarry at close range, Prosecutors fire their Umbra-pattern bolters in rapid bursts that sow strings of armour-shredding shots amongst the enemy.

synchronisedinferno.name: SYNCHRONISED INFERNO
synchronisedinferno.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKERS unit is selected to shoot.
synchronisedinferno.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly WITCHSEEKERS unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That WITCHSEEKERS unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s [TORRENT] ranged attacks have [BLAST 1].
synchronisedinferno.flavour: Coordinating through a rapid exchange of Thoughtmark, Witchseekers unleash a flesh-melting inferno of all-consuming promethium from their flamers.

hardenedresolve.name: HARDENED RESOLVE
hardenedresolve.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATORADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.
hardenedresolve.text:

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit has +1 T.
hardenedresolve.flavour: Steeling their souls and bracing their indomitable armour, heavily girded Custodians will cleave to their duty and reject attempts to cut them down.

electroexorcistsaturation.name: ELECTROEXORCIST SATURATION
electroexorcistsaturation.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.
electroexorcistsaturation.effect: Your unit’s Ballistus Grenade Launcher weapons have D3+3 A.
electroexorcistsaturation.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit is selected to shoot.

TARGET: That ADEPTUS CUSTODES TERMINATOR unit.

EFFECT: Your unit’s Ballistus Grenade Launcher weapons have D3+3 A.
electroexorcistsaturation.flavour: A concussive barrage of specialist grenades enables Allarus Custodians to maximise the destructive potential of their armmounted launchers against their massed enemies.

inescapablevengeance.name: INESCAPABLE VENGEANCE
inescapablevengeance.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.
inescapablevengeance.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can ignore Walls and other models for the purposes of determining which enemy units are visible to its own.
inescapablevengeance.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can ignore Walls and other models for the purposes of determining which enemy units are visible to its own.
inescapablevengeance.flavour: The incredible sensory acuity of the Custodians' wargear coupled with their superhuman senses means no foe can hide from them.

breachingbehemoths.name: BREACHING BEHEMOTHS
breachingbehemoths.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.
breachingbehemoths.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in your unit can move through other models as if they were not there. In addition, any Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed.
breachingbehemoths.text:
WHEN: Your Movement phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army (excluding ANATHEMA PSYKANA units) that has not been selected to move this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time your unit makes a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, models in your unit can move through other models as if they were not there. In addition, any Desperate Escape tests taken for models in your unit are automatically passed.
breachingbehemoths.flavour: When unleashed aboard an enemy voidship, Custodians simply smash a path through any who stand against them by their sheer armoured might.

artificerrounds.name: ARTIFICER ROUNDS
artificerrounds.target: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.
artificerrounds.effect: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding ballistus grenade launchers) have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting units within 6".
artificerrounds.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase.

TARGET: One ADEPTUS CUSTODES unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit (excluding ballistus grenade launchers) have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability while targeting units within 6".
artificerrounds.flavour: These hand-crafted bolt shells are made to fragment with particular ferocity, making them ideal for boarding actions.

auricstorm.name: AURIC STORM
auricstorm.when: Your Charge phase, just after an ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit from your army ends a Charge move.
auricstorm.effect: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
auricstorm.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, just after an ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit from your army ends a Charge move.

TARGET: That ALLARUS CUSTODIANS unit.

EFFECT: Each enemy unit within Engagement Range of your unit must take a Battle-shock test, subtracting 1 from the result.
auricstorm.flavour: Even the boldest foes falter before the sudden and unstoppable onslaught of the Allarus Terminators.

bladesofthevigilators.name: BLADES OF THE VIGILATORS
bladesofthevigilators.when: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
bladesofthevigilators.target: One VIGILATORS, ALEYA or KNIGHT-CENTURA equipped with an executioner greatblade unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.
bladesofthevigilators.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
bladesofthevigilators.text:

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
bladesofthevigilators.flavour: Though intended for lopping the heads from witches, the Vigilators' long blades also allow for skilful parrying of incoming attacks.

focusedfear.name: FOCUSED FEAR
focusedfear.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
focusedfear.target: One ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

EFFECT: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.
focusedfear.flavour: Fighting in the confines of a voidship heightens the fearful aura of the Sisters of Silence, fouling their foes'aim and weakening their sword arms.

corneredprey.when: Your Movement phase, just after an ANATHEMA PSYKANA unit from your army Falls Back.
corneredprey.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

EFFECT: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
corneredprey.flavour: Once they have their quarry trapped within a section of the voidship, the Silent Sisters relentlessly run them to ground.

punishmentoftheprosecutors.name: PUNISHMENT OF THE PROSECUTORS
punishmentoftheprosecutors.target: One PROSECUTORS unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by an additional 1.
punishmentoftheprosecutors.text:

EFFECT: Until the end of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit by 1. In addition, each time a model in your unit makes a ranged attack, on a Critical Wound, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by an additional 1.
punishmentoftheprosecutors.flavour: The Prosecutors cut down without mercy all who dare stand between the Silent Sisters and their prey.
